scope: Bounded DWG FIELD CadValue transport for type 0 with the R2007+ payload-suppression flag set. The value remains semantically unknown; this receipt does not establish FIELD evaluation or complete-source output support.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.rule: R2007+ stores Flags as BL code 93 followed by Data type as BL code 90. When the first flag bit is set, the type-specific payload is absent. Type 0 (Unknown) is BL only when that payload is present; the type BL remains in the suppressed profile.

corroboratingImplementation.rule: TABLE_value_fields reads format_flags and data_type, then skips the type-specific switch for R2007+ when format_flags & 1 is nonzero. This is implementation corroboration, not normative authority or independent semantic evidence.

behavior: Accept the bounded type-0 value when its recognized R2007+ flags suppress the payload.
Retain the type, flags, unit/format metadata, surrounding FIELD value string and following stream alignment without inventing an application value.
Permit DWG re-encoding only when the absent-payload value has no variant, raw bytes, data size or object handle.
Keep unsupported flags, unknown nonzero data types and malformed extra payload state refused.
implementation.fixturePolicy: Coverage uses generated in-memory vectors. No DWG or DXF fixture was added or committed.
